strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
Who'd have thought I'd end up coming all this way.
Operation Stardust foiled, the Apsaras Project scrapped...
Perhaps it was unavoidable...
So this is the Gandor Team? Surrounded, yet still holding out...!
Neo Zeon's Earth descent force, huh... Yeah, they look tough.
Nothing but mobile suits I've never seen.
Neo Zeon's... new models?
They've gathered this many Funnel-equipped units...
Looks like Zeon means business...!
Heh, half-baked weapons won't work on this Combattler V!
Let's just smash 'em!
Yeah, yeah! Let 'em have it!
Lots of these mobile suits can attack from long range...
The enemy means to use the terrain and pound us one-sidedly.
We'll have to get in close and overwhelm them with firepower.
Then that's perfect for the Shining Gundam.
Yeah, we've got no time to dawdle here.
...I'll finish this in one go.
Leave that kind of fight to me! I'll go out with a bang!
More like that's the only way you know how to fight, Koji.
Heh, it's no different for us. That's the only way we can fight.
Same goes for us.
We can only cut in head-on, after all.
We can repel beams, so this might suit us.
That's right. Getting close is the key...! Let's go, everyone!
All units, launch!
Their mobile suits seem to be mostly old models.
The question is... what to do about the types I've never seen...
So, who's first?
You look happy, Pai.
You bet! Diving in close to settle it... gets me fired up!
Pai, so manly~!
Hey, you guys! Take this a little more seriously!
Their vibe is just... you know.
Now, now, Tetsuya, they're reliable, so don't be so hard on them.
They seem awfully relaxed... I don't like it.
Right, signal the detachment deployed west of Jaburo.
Sir!
What? No contact with Jerid Messa's group!? What's... could it be!
Huh? What? The enemy seems kinda rattled...
What's going on? Can you tell, Cham?
...Maybe they tried to contact the mixed Titans unit on the other side.
This area is full of high-density Minovsky particles.
Communicating with each other should be difficult...
Good call, going around to that side first.
They meant to send reinforcements... but we crushed them first.
Then now's our chance, while the enemy's rattled.
It seems... the Titans remnants were not up to the task.
But... no, very well. It's about time anyway...
Let's hit them!
I'll return to Lady Haman. I leave the rest to you.
Hey! Wait a minute!
What a letdown.
What? He ran!?
Right after we got all fired up, too. How awful.
Be glad their forces are smaller... Stay sharp to the very end!
Ngh, they still had more allies...!?
Looks that way... Tch, what a pain.
Mobile suits? But those are... Titans mobile suits...
Hambrabi...! Amuro, no doubt about it! From the Gryps Conflict...!
Reinforcements from the Titans up north, huh.
Kukuku...
This feeling... Yazan Gable!?
The Gandor Team... my first real challenge in a while.
Let's have some fun.
You've come. With high-mobility units, our forces will be complete.
Now, we wipe out the Gandor Team, then go on to take Jaburo!
Sounds like he's talking pretty big, huh?
Bring it on! I'll show you battle's about quality, not numbers...!
Pai's right! Let's do this, everyone!
Yes!
Let's get 'em!
Plenty of spirit, at least... Commence the attack!
Damn... I can't fall in a place like this...
I still have things I must do...
Here he comes! It's that guy!
Tobikage... I'm counting on you!
However many times I see it, it reminds me of Gundam Spiegel.
Schwarz, huh...
...Where this robot comes from, and why it appears...
we'll have to figure that out someday.
No stiff talk right now, Kyosuke!
All right, don't let a single unit past!
We must keep them out of Jaburo, no matter what!
All riiight! Now I'm getting into the groove.
Phew, finally over. They were pretty tough.
Yeah, always attacking from so far away. So annoying.
They were a worthy opponent.
Just what you'd expect from Neo Zeon's main force.
But for them to throw a force this big at us...
means Zeon must be getting quite desperate.
Now if we can just retake Jaburo...
Yes, it'd give us a big advantage.
All right, after recovering all units, we head to the next point!
